features: staff-only static hosting engine: projects, sites, immutable deploys, previews, rollback, Git ingest, custom domains, takedowns, Media-backed objects and resource index

spaces at /spaces: an app made by the AI builder (OpenVibe.AI space.app.build) or from a template (guestbook, AI buddy, poll, reaction game, trivia, private to-dos, blank), forked, and edited in a browser editor with a sandboxed live preview

account export and deletion for spaces (ADR-033, openvibe-sdk/account-data)
